name: log-out
description: A right-pointing arrow leaving a rounded open door.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.

Both arrows point right: entry shaft x7.5..12.5 / head base x9.5, exit shaft x11.5..16.5 / head base x13.5, at y12 with head arms y9..15. Filled uses the exact radius.875 expansion of the C door, outer radius2.375 / inner radius.625, and an analytical merged shaft/solid-head contour; door and arrow stay disjoint. All None/Square/Circle forms reuse exactly the same native glyph, with no per-frame scale or translation. Outline is Regular1.75 with round caps/joins; Thin1.25 and Bold2.50 use the same centerlines. Standard solid frame exteriors are bounds2..22, Square radius4 / Circle radius10; Outline frame centerlines are bounds2.875..21.125 with radius3.125 / circle radius9.125. Frames remain upright, with2px default outer margins. Framed Filled subtracts the exact standalone Filled silhouette as transparent negative space. All geometry is original to this project; external references establish meaning only. Native X/Y100/100, rotation0. All new forms remain draft pending owner review.
